2608.01862.title: Wnuan: Staged Post-Training for Question Answering over Proprietary Enterprise Knowledge
2608.01862.paper_summary: Enterprise question answering requires models to acquire proprietary knowledge without discarding general capabilities. We present Wnuan, a three-stage pipeline that constructs task-oriented supervision from documents, performs supervised fine-tuning with general-data replay, and applies reinforcement learning to residual errors. On the 707-question WnuanBench, the primary 32B route raises acceptable-answer rate (AAR) from 52.76% before adaptation to 80.06% after SFT and 91.51% after RL. Under a matched 100-update protocol, residual-error sampling outperforms full-pool and size-matched random sampling by 3.11 and 2.97 points, respectively. Source-cluster bootstrap intervals remain above zero for both contrasts, and a same-domain validation set preserves the ordering. The general-benchmark average decreases by 5.17 points across the route, concentrated in instruction following. The automatic evaluation ensemble agrees with an authoritative domain expert on 90.5% of a stratified Wnuan-Inst response sample. These results characterize both the gains and the general-capability cost of staged enterprise adaptation.
2608.01862.paper_summary_zh: 企業問答需要模型在不放棄一般能力的情況下獲取專有知識。我們提出了Wnuan，一個三階段的管道，從文檔中構建以任務為導向的監督，進行一般數據重播的有監督微調，並對殘餘錯誤應用強化學習。在707個問題的WnuanBench上，主要的32B路徑將可接受答案率（AAR）從適應前的52.76%提高到SFT後的80.06%以及RL後的91.51%。在匹配的100次更新協議下，殘餘錯誤抽樣分別比全池和大小匹配的隨機抽樣高出3.11和2.97點。源集群自助引導區間在兩個對比中均保持在零以上，同一領域的驗證集保留了排序。一般基準的平均值在整個路徑上下降了5.17點，集中在指令遵循上。自動評估集成與權威領域專家在90.5%的分層Wnuan-Inst回應樣本上達成一致。這些結果表徵了階段性企業適應的增益和一般能力成本。
